Remark
[Soul theorem for positive curvature] ↗ thm:soul-theorem

The positive-curvature case used below has a point soul; this case first appeared in \cite{GromollMeyer}.

The remaining soul-theorem consequences follow the comparison-geometric construction in \cite{Petersen}.
